rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the robot fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's energy at the start of the turn must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: the 1 rule holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved rule S1, "Never fire a shot you can't afford": whenever the robot fires, the power is between 100 and 3000 and below its current energy. The code only fires power 100 when energy is above 100, so the proof holds. Neither battle (open arena or city map) showed any violations.
